rule: Primary full_adapt versus plain_adapt only. Deterministic selection: one available net-rescue, net-harm, consistent-CC and consistent-WW query, then missing vv_only and vh_only coverage where available, then fill to eight using the completed-round helper ranking. Never invent absent states. Representative seed is the largest absolute fixed-rival margin change within its state. Fixed rival is the strongest nontruth class in mean full_fit logits across three orders, shared by all comparisons.
